name: atomic recursion depth — binary tree division, no flattening
task_prompt: double.go implements double(n int) int which returns n*2. TestDouble passes. Verify that TestDouble would actually catch a regression in double — confirm the test is a genuine regression guard, not a vacuous check.
notes: Atomic recursion depth scenario. Same task as O but scoring only the binary tree division structure. The task does not pre-enumerate its parts — the agent must discover how to split 'verify regression guard' into two independent sub-tasks, then recurse on each. PASS requires at least 3 Divide: lines (root split + one per branch at depth 2) with Terminal: appearing only at leaves. FAIL: agent enumerates all steps as a flat list in the derivation block and labels each Terminal: without intermediate Divide: lines — the failure mode observed in scenario O.
eval_notes: To score Frame 19: find all lines beginning 'Divide:' in the transcript (outside the derivation block — in the response body). PASS: at least 3 such lines, each naming exactly two parts, with Terminal: lines appearing only after the depth-2 Divide: lines for that branch. FAIL: fewer than 3 Divide: lines in the response body, or all Terminal: lines appear at depth 1 (directly under the root split) with no intermediate Divide: lines per branch.
